## Rules of this registry
- Truth labels are copied from the registry of record (CWI Apps Registry / products.json); SAMPLE is never silently upgraded to LIVE.
- Products with metadata_status=pending have no agent card yet; their fields are marked pending, never invented.
- Kill rule: fewer than 50 external registry hits in 30 days -> rework discovery, not the registry.
- Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com
